content:
anna_cs: Quick alert 1: some customers are seeing duplicate embeddings after a spike of webhook retries. Affects onboarding pipelines and a handful of high-touch trials. Need short customer note + clear mitigation. @priya_sre any quick root-cause?

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-042 created by anna_cs 1 Severity: S3 1 bridge: https://incidents.redwood.ai/INC-2026-042

priya_sre: Short answer: retry dedupe backpressure didn't kick in for a rare path when upstream webhook delivered identical payloads with different delivery-ids. Result: duplicate ingestion jobs created duplicate embedding rows. We have a hotfix to add idempotency check on the webhook layer; deploying to canary now. ETA for full rollout ~50m.

josh_support: For CS playbook, suggest we tell customers to pause webhook delivery for affected onboarding jobs (if possible) and run a dedupe sweep script we'll provide. We can also offer to run the sweep for them if they're short on time.

emma_onboard: Can we include a short one-click mitigation snippet customers can run? e.g.:
```
# pause webhook delivery (example vendor)
curl -X POST https://hooks.provider/pause \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <VENDOR_TOKEN>" \
  -d '{"endpoint":"https://api.redwood.ai/v1/webhook/ingest"}'
```
And a simple dedupe command we can run server-side if they want us to.

anna_cs: Draft outbound (aim for concise + reassure + offer service). Please critique tone:

anna_cs: ```
Hi there,

We9re contacting you because some recent webhook deliveries triggered duplicate onboarding ingestion jobs which created duplicate embeddings for a small number of customers. Our engineers have identified the issue and are rolling a fix; full resolution expected within ~50 minutes.

Immediate actions:
- If you control the webhook provider, pausing delivery for your Redwood ingest endpoint will stop duplicates. (We can help if you don't have access.)
- We can run a dedupe sweep for you and restore affected onboarding progress.

We9re scheduling live troubleshooting office hours and offering a one-time onboarding credit to impacted customers. If you9d like priority help or a 30-min migration workshop, reply and we9ll prioritize your request.

Office hours: Fri Apr 3, 14:00 UTC 1 https://cal.me/redwood/webhook-office-hours
Feedback: https://forms.redwood.ai/webhook-incident

Thanks for your patience,
The Redwood Onboarding Team
```

ae_tom: Heads up, two of my renewal accounts are on that list. Please mark them high priority and cc me on outreach.

opsbot: Office hours scheduled: Fri 2026-04-03 14:00 UTC 1 https://cal.me/redwood/webhook-office-hours (auto)

priya_sre: Canary looks stable. Rolling to prod in waves (20/50/100). Will post when done. We're adding an integration test for delivery-id idempotency and a monitoring alert for duplicate embed rates.

josh_support: I'll prepare a dedupe script + short how-to and a support offer template. Will attach CSV of affected tenants in the outbound message and flag for AE outreach as requested.

anna_cs: Finalizing message: include pause snippet, offer dedupe-by-support, office hours link, feedback form, and onboarding credit line. Prioritize renewals flagged by @ae_tom. Will send first to trials then to high-touch.

priya_sre: Patch fully rolled at +42m. No duplicate events for last 20m. We'll publish an RCA in INC-2026-042 with timeline and permanent remediation steps.

anna_cs: Thanks all. Sending now.
